```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

## 1. Design and planning assumptions

```{r parameters}
n_domains <- 4
n_cells <- 4
alpha <- 0.05
alpha_domain <- alpha / n_domains
target_power <- 0.95
d_target <- 0.20
rho_performance <- 0.60
d_adjusted <- d_target / sqrt(1 - rho_performance^2)
attrition_rate <- 0.30
```

## 2. H1/H2: AI effect without incentive

We approximate the baseline-adjusted AI contrast within each domain using a one-sided two-sample t-test with $d=`r d_target`/\sqrt{1-`r rho_performance`^2}=`r round(d_adjusted, 3)`$ to determine the analyzable sample per cell.

```{r h1-h2}
h1_h2 <- pwr::pwr.t.test(
  d = -d_adjusted, sig.level = alpha_domain, power = target_power,
  type = "two.sample", alternative = "less"
)
n_cell <- ceiling(h1_h2$n)
N_domain <- n_cells * n_cell
N_total <- n_domains * N_domain

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Quantity = c("Required n per cell, before rounding", "Planned n per cell per domain",
               "All four cells per domain", "Full study across four domains",
               "H1/H2 no-incentive subset across domains"),
  Value = c(sprintf("%.1f", h1_h2$n), n_cell, N_domain, N_total,
            2 * n_cell * n_domains)
), col.names = c("Quantity", "Participants"))
```

<details>
<summary>Detailed results</summary>

```{r h1-h2-raw}
print(h1_h2, digits = 4)
```

</details>

### Recruitment allowing for attrition

We divide each cell's analyzable target by the expected retention of `r 100 * (1 - attrition_rate)`% and round up to obtain balanced recruitment targets.

```{r attrition}
n_recruit_cell <- ceiling(n_cell / (1 - attrition_rate))
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Quantity = c("Recruit per cell per domain", "Recruit per domain",
               "Recruit across four domains"),
  Participants = c(n_recruit_cell, n_cells * n_recruit_cell,
                   n_domains * n_cells * n_recruit_cell)
))
```

## 3. H3/H4: incentive effect within AI

We apply the same planning assumptions to the positive incentive contrast within the AI condition, using participants from the same study sample.

```{r h3-h4}
h3_h4 <- pwr::pwr.t.test(
  d = d_adjusted, sig.level = alpha_domain, power = target_power,
  type = "two.sample", alternative = "greater"
)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  n_per_cell = ceiling(h3_h4$n),
  N_per_domain_contrast = 2 * ceiling(h3_h4$n),
  N_contrast_across_domains = 2 * ceiling(h3_h4$n) * n_domains
), col.names = c("n per cell per domain", "N per domain contrast",
                 "N across four domains"))
```

<details>
<summary>Detailed results</summary>

```{r h3-h4-raw}
print(h3_h4, digits = 4)
```

</details>

## 4. H5/H6: pooled AI × incentive interaction

We use the planned sample to approximate the minimum detectable interaction averaged equally across domains.

```{r h5-h6}
n_cell_pooled <- n_domains * n_cell
d_int_mde_unadjusted <- (qnorm(1 - alpha) + qnorm(target_power)) *
  sqrt(4 / n_cell_pooled)
d_int_mde <- d_int_mde_unadjusted * sqrt(1 - rho_performance^2)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  N = N_total,
  n_per_pooled_cell = n_cell_pooled,
  d_int_MDE_adjusted = round(d_int_mde, 3),
  d_int_MDE_unadjusted = round(d_int_mde_unadjusted, 3)
), col.names = c("Pooled N", "n per factorial cell across domains",
                 "Interaction MDE with baseline adjustment (outcome SD units)",
                 "Interaction MDE without baseline adjustment (outcome SD units)"))
```

<details>
<summary>Detailed results</summary>

```{r h5-h6-raw}
print(c(d_int_MDE_adjusted = d_int_mde,
        d_int_MDE_unadjusted = d_int_mde_unadjusted), digits = 4)
```

</details>

## 5. H7: pooled signed metacognitive bias

We use the planned no-incentive sample to find the minimum detectable positive AI effect on signed metacognitive bias averaged equally across domains.

```{r h7}
n_h7_per_AI_level <- n_domains * n_cell
h7_power <- pwr::pwr.t.test(
  n = n_h7_per_AI_level, d = d_target, sig.level = alpha,
  type = "two.sample", alternative = "greater"
)
h7_mde <- pwr::pwr.t.test(
  n = n_h7_per_AI_level, sig.level = alpha, power = target_power,
  type = "two.sample", alternative = "greater"
)$d

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  n_per_AI_level = n_h7_per_AI_level,
  N_no_incentive = 2 * n_h7_per_AI_level,
  Cohen_d_MDE = round(h7_mde, 3),
  power_at_d_0_20 = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * h7_power$power)
), col.names = c("n per AI level across domains", "Pooled no-incentive N",
                 "Cohen's d MDE", "Power at d = 0.20"))
```

<details>
<summary>Detailed results</summary>

```{r h7-raw}
print(h7_power, digits = 4)
print(c(Cohen_d_MDE = h7_mde), digits = 4)
```

</details>

## 6. Prolific cost estimate

```{r prolific-costs}
currency        <- "GBP"  # label only
prolific_hourly <- 9.00   # GBP per hour
session_minutes <- c(18, 13, 24, 11) # rounded observed minutes: baseline, training 1, training 2 + immediate test, delayed test
# Assumed gaps: 1 week after baseline, shorter gap after training, 1 week after immediate test.
gap_attrition   <- c(0.12, 0.05, NA_real_)
gap_attrition[3] <- 1 - (1 - attrition_rate) / prod(1 - gap_attrition[1:2])
prolific_fee    <- 0.33   # Prolific service fee on participant rewards
vat_rate        <- 0.00   # VAT on the service fee (0.20 UK/EU; 0 if exempt)

# Performance bonus in the two incentivized C+ arms
bonus_per_item        <- 0.30 # GBP paid per correct item in the C+ arms
n_items               <- 10
expected_prop_correct <- 0.50 # expected fraction correct -> expected bonus base
frac_bonus_arms       <- 0.50 # 2 of the 4 factorial cells are incentivized (C+)

n_recruit         <- n_domains * n_cells * n_recruit_cell # balanced recruitment target
session_n         <- c(n_recruit, ceiling(n_recruit * cumprod(1 - gap_attrition)))
session_rewards   <- session_n * session_minutes / 60 * prolific_hourly
minutes_total     <- sum(session_minutes)
reward_per_person <- prolific_hourly * (minutes_total / 60)
base_pay_total    <- sum(session_rewards)

n_bonus_recruit  <- ceiling(session_n[3] * frac_bonus_arms) # bonus earned at immediate test
bonus_per_person <- bonus_per_item * n_items * expected_prop_correct
bonus_total      <- n_bonus_recruit * bonus_per_person

rewards_total     <- base_pay_total + bonus_total # Prolific fee applies to bonuses too
service_fee       <- rewards_total * prolific_fee
vat_total         <- service_fee * vat_rate
grand_total       <- rewards_total + service_fee + vat_total
cost_per_analyzed <- grand_total / N_total

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Quantity = c("Analyzable sample", "Attrition", "Participants to recruit",
               "Attrition between sessions", "Participants by session",
               "Session durations (minutes)", "Total duration (minutes)",
               "Reward for all four sessions", "Base rewards by session",
               "Base participant rewards", "Bonus-eligible participants at immediate test",
               "Expected bonus per eligible participant", "Performance bonuses",
               "Participant rewards including bonuses", "Prolific service fee",
               "VAT on service fee", "Total study cost", "Cost per analyzable participant"),
  Value = c(N_total, sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * attrition_rate), n_recruit,
            paste(sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * gap_attrition), collapse = " / "),
            paste(session_n, collapse = " / "),
            paste(session_minutes, collapse = " / "), minutes_total,
            sprintf("%s %.2f", currency, reward_per_person),
            paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", currency, session_rewards), collapse = " / "),
            sprintf("%s %.2f", currency, base_pay_total), n_bonus_recruit,
            sprintf("%s %.2f", currency, c(bonus_per_person, bonus_total,
                    rewards_total, service_fee, vat_total, grand_total,
                    cost_per_analyzed)))
))

```

### Per-participant cost and maximum bonus

We calculate the cost of completing all sessions in each arm, including fees and either the expected or maximum performance bonus.

```{r cost-per-participant}
overhead  <- 1 + prolific_fee * (1 + vat_rate) # fee (+VAT) charged on every reward pound
max_bonus <- bonus_per_item * n_items          # every scored item correct

cost_control   <- reward_per_person * overhead
cost_bonus_exp <- (reward_per_person + bonus_per_person) * overhead
cost_bonus_max <- (reward_per_person + max_bonus) * overhead

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Quantity = c("Base pay for all sessions", "Expected bonus (C+)",
               "Maximum bonus (C+)", "Cost per control participant (C−)",
               "Cost per bonus participant, expected (C+)",
               "Cost per bonus participant, maximum (C+)",
               "Cost per analyzable participant"),
  Amount = sprintf("%s %.2f", currency,
                   c(reward_per_person, bonus_per_person, max_bonus,
                     cost_control, cost_bonus_exp, cost_bonus_max,
                     cost_per_analyzed))
))
```
